challenged_claim: The epsilon-zero shared-hub L2 operator can be applied after freezing each bank's P-coordinate and then integrated by absolute Minkowski with a universal constant supplied by the bounded-density projection theorem.
correction: False even for a perfectly conditioned authentic product projection. For every N>=3, take iid fragmented cap-one X1,X2 supported on N intervals of length 1/N with Sidon-separated centers and independent X3~Unif[0,1], then set L=(X1+X2)/sqrt(2), V=X3, P=(X1-X2)/sqrt(2). The 3x3 coefficient map is orthogonal and the projected joint density is an indicator bounded by one, but integral ||g(.,.,p)||_{L2(dl dv)} dp = 2^(-1/4)*(4/3)*[(N-1)/sqrt(N)+1/N] ~ 1.121195 sqrt(N). Two-bank fixed-P/Minkowski therefore loses order N. This does not refute QFORM; it forces the epsilon-uniform bridge to retain P-frequency/Hilbert-space cancellation until after bank aggregation.
